component.name: Cards With Cats
component.summary: Play four classic card games against clever cats

description.p: Play Hearts, Spades, Oh Hell, and four-player Scum against three computer-controlled cats. Each mode includes configurable rules, responsive card-table controls, persistent matches, and opponents with distinct strategy.

screenshot.caption: Choose from four card games against a table of cats
A Scum match with a clear player hand and centered play area

description.p: Adds the current menu and in-game screenshots to AppStream for display in SpacedBazaar.
Renamed the app to Cards With Cats, prevented Scum plays from covering the human hand, and polished the shared table, cards, menus, and transitions.
Added a Scum rules summary to the About dialog.
Fixed rounds freezing when a match was started with the menu still open; added watchdog recovery.
Play button moved to the right-hand side, Pass to the left, both inset toward the middle.
Initial release of the Scum game mode.
